provenance: A Creality Ender-3 Pro (V4.2.2 board) retrofitted with a Creality Nebula Pad as its Klipper host, as its owner's machine reports itself (debug bundle CH3SN4T8)
notes: The Nebula Pad is a MIPS Ingenic host running Creality's Buildroot image. It also ships on the Ender-3 V3 SE/KE and retrofits onto an Ender-3 / Pro / V2, so nothing it reports names which Ender it drives.
hostname is the pad's own default. The pad is not a FlashForge, whose hosts are also MIPS Ingenic.
The PRINTER_PARAM / STRUCTURE_PARAM / CX_PRINT_LEVELING_CALIBRATION / FIRST_FLOOR_* macros are Creality's stock gcode_macro.cfg; _GUPPY_VARS is the Helper Script's GuppyScreen.
steppers is empty because objects/list carries no stepper_* objects on this firmware. build_volume is the stepper travel from toolhead axis limits.
The secondary MCU is the pad's own Linux host MCU.
